subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should channels without native grouping metadata, starting with LINE, get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel contract, or no heuristic batching support?
rationale: The remaining behavior adds delayed webhook semantics and public configuration for platforms without reliable album ids, so automation should not choose defaults, keying, flush behavior, or plugin-vs-core ownership.

options.title: LINE opt-in media buffer
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin setting and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared channel contract first
options.body: Design a media-aware channel SDK/core contract before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep heuristic batching unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram album buffering only and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: LINE opt-in media buffer
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin setting and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current history on the LINE handler files where the plugin-local option would land.
